reuse.why: Most month-wide actions share the new selection helpers and reuse existing budget, spreadsheet, batching, and undo abstractions, but copyPreviousMonth retains its own eligibility logic.

duplication.why: The change consolidates several queries but duplicates template-status SQL across two loaders and eligibility rules between copyPreviousMonth and shouldSetMonthBudget.

placement.why: Selection and budget calculations remain in budget/actions.ts, while handler registration and undo wrapping follow budget/app.ts conventions.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, and focused tests.

maintainability.why: The shared helpers improve ownership, but maintaining parallel eligibility predicates and template-status expressions leaves future rule changes vulnerable to drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth independently applies the rules encapsulated by shouldSetMonthBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth expresses shouldSetMonthBudget's eligibility decision as separate rejection checks with inverted conditions.

abstraction_drift.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: shouldSetMonthBudget gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter, while copyPreviousMonth independently evolves the same eligibility policy.
